page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. This instance provides 40 physical cores and 40 vCPUs, operating at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.8 GB of RAM per core. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.hfg6.10xlarge demonstrates stable mid-range performance. The single-core stress-ng CPU test yielded a score of 1438.99, while the multi-core stress-ng metric reached 38378.07. Cryptographic and vector processing capabilities are supported by AVX, AVX-512, and AES instruction sets, reflected in a Passmark CPU extended instructions score of 35214.09. Memory subsystem testing shows a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2133.36 GB/sec, which drops to 108.89 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, and a write bandwidth of 48.09 GB/sec.

Database and memory-bound operations are characterized by a Passmark database score of 14249.04 and a Redis SET throughput of 34.78 million operations per second. For software development tasks, the Geekbench clang compilation benchmark scored 28733.0. Large language model inference speeds on CPU-only execution reach 1841.39 tokens per second for prompt processing with a small 135M model, but drop to 56.94 tokens per second for a medium 7B model. The lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware limits its utility for high-throughput local database storage or heavy deep learning training workloads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high clock speed provide predictable compute performance without the resource contention of shared-core environments. This makes the instance suitable for workloads requiring sustained CPU performance, such as static web serving, which achieved 25.35 GB/sec throughput, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and general-purpose enterprise applications that rely on network-attached storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 server instance featuring 40 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.8 GB of memory per core, but lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Network performance is anchored by a 12 Gbps baseline bandwidth. Benchmark data indicates solid mid-range capabilities, with a multi-core stress-ng score of 38378.07 and a Passmark CPU score of 34691.95. The instance excels at multi-threaded tasks, achieving a bzip3 decompression speed of 166.28 GB/sec and a static web serving throughput of 25.35 GB/sec. Given its dedicated compute resources and lack of local storage, this instance is best suited for enterprise web serving, software compilation, and memory-conscious general-purpose workloads utilizing network-attached storage.
